recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No additional core source change is needed for FHIR-7732; retain the existing FHIR-32960 source-changing reconciliation as the current cleanup for the shared vaccine-boundary paragraph.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy DSTU1 clarification asking what it meant for systems that use MedicationAdministration to capture vaccinations to also expose an equivalent Immunization instance; the resolution retained the Immunization guidance and clarified that systems should create the Immunization instance as well.
initial_application: Git commit 5555750a4cce94cd357c3178441d043caa13f1ca explicitly listed #7732 and changed the MedicationAdministration introduction from "SHOULD also expose an equivalent Immunization instance" to "SHOULD also create and expose an equivalent Immunization instance."
additional_context: MedicationAdministration and Immunization are active current-build resources. Later Published issue FHIR-32960 revisited the same vaccine boundary and is already represented on the combined branch by b7214bc5256739e402b4118bf12c9492f9291cbd, which normalized the MedicationAdministration wording and aligned the paired Immunization Boundaries paragraph. A 2017 Zulip thread quoted the guidance without conflict, and Confluence reference search found no FHIR-7732 pages.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current MedicationAdministration and Immunization introduction pages both say that vaccine administration is intended to be handled using Immunization and that, if MedicationAdministration is needed for vaccination workflow or other reasons, systems SHOULD also create and expose an equivalent Immunization instance.
